projects.title: Shopify Store Duplicator
projects.description: A Python tool that fully clones a Shopify store from one account to another via the API: products, collections, pages, blog articles, menus, policies, discounts and theme. It maintains a dynamic mapping table to remap internal IDs between stores, and surgically replaces the source domain with the target domain across all HTML content (descriptions, metafields, theme JSON).

projects.title: Shopify Product Page Optimizer
projects.description: An n8n workflow that reads a list of products from Google Sheets, fetches each one via the Shopify API, then automatically generates 4 distinct SEO elements with Claude: main keyword, tags, product description and meta description, key features. The data is pushed back to Shopify with delays to respect API rate limits.

projects.title: Automated Market Newsletter
projects.description: An n8n workflow that scrapes 3 public Telegram channels via HTTP Request, extracts and filters news from the last 24h, aggregates it, then generates an HTML newsletter summarized by Claude Haiku and sends it automatically by email every morning.
